name: Corte Constitucional
body: A meta description, a share image, a declared language, and a start page that arrives fast. But that HTML holds no readable text and no h1: the content is drawn by JavaScript, which most AI crawlers do not run.
lesson: Server-render the main text and headings. AI crawlers and slow phones read HTML first.
summary: www.corteconstitucional.gov.co scores 73 out of 100 (C). 4 checks fail now, 21 are at risk, and 11 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: AI crawlers see an almost empty start page
fix.evidence: The HTML carries 0 characters of readable text. Most AI crawlers do not run JavaScript.
fix.fix: Render the main content on the server or pre-render it at build time.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Analytics 4 appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: Core Web Vitals fail for real visitors
fix.evidence: Real Chrome users over the last 28 days on this page, at the 75th percentile: Largest Contentful Paint 4.6 s (poor), Interaction to Next Paint 247 ms (needs improvement), Cumulative Layout Shift 0.44 (poor). Source: Chrome UX Report through PageSpeed Insights.
fix.fix: Make the largest element arrive sooner: preload the hero image, serve it at the shown size in a modern format, and cut render-blocking scripts. Reserve space for images, embeds, ads, and late banners. Break up long…

fix.title: Lighthouse scores performance 12/100 on mobile
fix.evidence: Lighthouse 13.5.0 on a simulated mid-range phone over slow 4G: Largest Contentful Paint 45.5 s, Total Blocking Time 1217 ms, Cumulative Layout Shift 0.429, Speed Index 15.7 s.
fix.fix: Open PageSpeed Insights for this URL and work through its opportunities, largest savings first.

fix.title: No Organization or Person entity describes who is behind the site
fix.evidence: AI answers lean on this to name the brand, its logo, and its profiles.
fix.fix: Add Organization (or Person) JSON-LD with name, url, logo, and sameAs. The fix kit has a draft.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http does not serve the site
The start page declares its language
The start page arrived in 192 ms
Every page has a meta description
The start page sets a mobile viewport
